questions.question: The statement of Fermat’s little theorem omits the condition that a and p are coprime; agree its addition in both editions. Also decide whether the last theorem should explicitly state that the exponent n is an integer.

localizations.source: The statement of Fermat’s little theorem omits the condition that a and p are coprime; agree its addition in both editions. Also decide whether the last theorem should explicitly state that the exponent n is an integer.
localizations.ru: В формулировке малой теоремы Ферма отсутствует условие взаимной простоты a и p; согласовать его добавление в обе версии. Также уточнить, следует ли явно назвать целочисленность показателя n в Великой теореме.

questions.resolution: The little theorem now states p∤a, and the last theorem specifies integer n.

questions.question: Verify the descriptions of Fermat as the founder of algebraic number theory and as never publishing.

localizations.source: Verify the descriptions of Fermat as the founder of algebraic number theory and as never publishing.
localizations.ru: Проверить формулировки «основоположник алгебраической теории чисел» и «не публиковался».

questions.resolution: The historical claims about Fermat’s role and circulation of his work were made more precise and neutral.

questions.question: Correct the historical attribution in the paragraph on Fermat numbers: Fermat conjectured that every number F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1 is prime, whereas the open question whether there are finitely or infinitely many Fermat primes is a modern formulation and was not posed by him in that form.

localizations.source: Correct the historical attribution in the paragraph on Fermat numbers: Fermat conjectured that every number F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1 is prime, whereas the open question whether there are finitely or infinitely many Fermat primes is a modern formulation and was not posed by him in that form.
localizations.ru: Исправить историческую атрибуцию абзаца о числах Ферма: Ферма предполагал, что все числа F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1 простые, тогда как открытый вопрос о конечности или бесконечности множества простых чисел Ферма является современной формулировкой и не был поставлен им в таком виде.

questions.resolution: Fermat’s conjecture is separated from the modern open question about the number of Fermat primes.
